original_launcher.source_text:
.PHONY: sync dev test clean

sync:
	uv sync

dev: sync
	GALILEO_PROJECT=galileo-agent-demo GALILEO_LOG_STREAM=production OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=galileo-agent-demo uv run uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8040

test: sync
	uv run python -m compileall app.py

clean:
	rm -rf .venv __pycache__ .pytest_cache .observe

candidate_launcher.source_text:
.PHONY: sync dev dev-studio test clean

sync:
	uv sync

dev: sync
	GALILEO_PROJECT=galileo-agent-demo GALILEO_LOG_STREAM=production OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=galileo-agent-demo uv run uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8040

dev-studio:
	uv sync --locked
	uv run --locked --env-file .env.studio uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8040

test: sync
	uv run --locked python -m compileall -q app.py studio_telemetry.py ao_resources.py tests
	OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

clean:
	rm -rf .venv __pycache__ .pytest_cache .observe

candidate_profile.source_text:
# Copy to .env.studio and select with make dev-studio.
# Studio discovery unavailable in this run: fill the actual numeric loopback
# API origin and HTTP/protobuf trace endpoint, preserving their real ports.
STUDIO_ROUTE_ENABLED=true
STUDIO_API_ORIGIN=
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT=
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf
# Bound selection: project/stream are named targets, not existing resources.
STUDIO_PROJECT=galileo-agent-demo
STUDIO_AGENT_STREAM=galileo-agent-demo-live
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=galileo-agent-demo
OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=deployment.environment.name=local
OTEL_BSP_SCHEDULE_DELAY=100
# Existing harmless trace headers are retained; conflicting selectors fail closed.
# No metric/log exporter is added by AO-001. Galileo credentials stay operator-owned.
